source_admission: Published values used in tubes.py, highlands.py, run.py and README.md; no external dataset files are admitted beyond the geography domain's hash-checked inputs (LOLA, GRAIL GL0420A and the IAU gazetteer archive). Two literature agents fetched and read the sources on 2026-10-11 with web tools, recording quotes and their places; "access" says how far each was read. Values from figures were read from the figure images. Where a paper could not be read, the value comes from the document named in "access". Project products are cited by path in the README and hashed in results/land_cities.json.

sources.citation: LROC Lunar Pits Atlas (Arizona State University), pages 1-21 and the list
sources.use: Every pit outside impact melt: coordinates, funnel and inner diameters, depths (stereo or shadow), overhangs; 16 mare pits
